=====8<===== FILE: settings.md
# config.md

Settings the coordinator reads on every run. All values are starting
defaults, not evidence-based targets. Review them at the first monthly retro.

## Cadence

- Scout: weekdays
- Weekly review: Friday
- Monthly retro: first Monday of the month
- Research refresh: every 90 days, or when a retro recommends it

## Limits

- Active opportunities (status `go`, `ready`, `applied` or `interview`): 5
- New promotions per run: 3
- Items in `NEXT.md`: 3
- Questions surfaced at once: 1

## Thresholds that trigger an early retro

- 10 applications sent with no reply of any kind
- 3 interviews with no offer
- 15 working days with no new screened-in signal

## Screening

- Minimum scout score to promote (1 to 5): 3
- Hard filters: taken from `profile/target.md` (locations, contract types,
  level, deal-breakers)

## Checks

- Attempts to fix a failing check before stopping and telling the candidate: 2

## Notifications

If the environment offers a notification or message tool, send the contents of
`NEXT.md` whenever it changes. Otherwise write the file only.
=====8<===== FILE: questions.md
# Questions

One global queue. Only the first unanswered question is shown in `NEXT.md`.
Answer in chat, or here on the line beginning `A:`. Answers are copied into
`profile/evidence-bank.md` on the next run, and the question is marked
`[answered <date>]`.

Format:

Q1 [affects: <opportunity>, <opportunity>] <question>
A:
=====8<===== FILE: NEXT.md
# Next

Written by the script from the state of your search. At most three items.

1. Your turn: Read and send your application to Testville Hall, Production Assistant. Closes 20 December.
2. Your turn: Research your field. Switch Research on and say "Research my field".

=====8<===== FILE: profile/evidence-bank.md
# Evidence bank

The only source of facts about the candidate beyond the master CV. Every claim
in a tailored CV or covering note must trace to a line here or to the CV. The
checking script enforces this.

Rules:
- One fact per line, in this form:
  `- E001 | 2026-01-31 | intake | <what was done, the scale, the result, and where proof can be found>`
- Ids run E001, E002, E003 and are never reused or renumbered.
- The third field says where the fact came from: `intake`, `answer Q7`, or
  `debrief <opportunity>`.
- Append only. To correct a fact, add a new line and end the old one with
  `(superseded by E0nn)`.
- Nothing inferred. If the candidate did not say it, it does not go here.

## Facts
- E001 | 2026-11-26 | intake | Stage crew volunteer at Testville Arts Festival 2024 and 2025, load-in for 12 acts
- E002 | 2026-11-26 | intake | Built weekly rotas in Excel for 9 bar staff

## Known gaps, stated by the candidate

What the search is aiming at. The scout uses this for hard filters. Changes
after setup go through Gate C (a retro proposal the candidate approves).

- Role types and titles: production assistant
- Level (entry, early career, experienced, senior): entry
- Locations, including remote: Testville
- Contract types acceptable (permanent, fixed term, freelance, internship):
- Minimum pay, if any:
- Hours and availability constraints:

<anything that screens a role out immediately>

## What success looks like
<the outcome the candidate wants, and by when>
